execution_change.predecessor_ordering: patch-outer / cells-inner, one per-patch cache shared across the 4 cells
execution_change.why: a cell can only be finalized when all 3,994 of its patches are done; under patch-outer no cell reaches that boundary until all four do (~50h). Per-cell durability therefore REQUIRES cells-outer, which forfeits the cross-cell cache. The two are mutually exclusive; this is structural, not an implementation choice.
